description: Set a form field's value in one step — input, textarea, or a rich-text editor such as ProseMirror, Lexical or Slate. Writes through the native value setter and then fires input and change, which is what React and Vue listen for. Returns {filled} naming the field. Use session_type instead when a field only reacts to real keystrokes, and session_select for a dropdown.

ref.description: A ref from session_snapshot, such as @e12, used instead of selector

selector.description: CSS selector for the field to fill

tabId.description: Tab to act on; uses the active tab when omitted

value.description: Text to place in the field, replacing whatever is there

name: session_fill
